tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Adds a product variant (specific size/color combination) to the cart. Requires user confirmation. Returns the updated cart summary.

variant_id.description: The variant ID (NOT the product ID). Get this from get_product → variants.

tools.name: apply_coupon
tools.description: Apply a promotion or discount code to the current cart. Returns whether the promo was accepted.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch full details for one product by slug, including variants (sizes/colors) and stock status.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Returns the store name, currency, API base URL, and pointers to all /.well-known/ discovery endpoints.

tools.name: go_to_checkout
tools.description: Navigates the current tab to the checkout page for the active cart. Requires user confirmation.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Returns top-level and nested categories (taxons) of the apparel catalog — Men, Women, Sportswear, Brands, Collections, and promotional groupings.

parent.description: Optional permalink filter for children of a given parent, e.g. 'categories/men'.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search for apparel products by name, category (taxon permalink), price range, or stock status. Returns up to 20 results with name, price, and URL.

query.description: Keyword to match against product names, e.g. 'denim shirt'.

in_stock.description: If true, only return purchasable items in stock.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: Returns the agent's current cart (line items, quantities, totals). Creates an empty cart if none exists.
